biography:
As a senior leader in real estate development and redevelopment strategies, I have a passion for commercial real estate, a drive to develop clear, tailored programs founded on data and experience.  My thirteen years of experience bring a comprehensive and diverse palette of skill sets backed by a cultural intelligence that embraces innovation in the global marketplace.
Effective leaders need to connect well with their teams, providing motivation and guidance to help people form focused goals.  This creates an atmosphere of cohesion and confidence — propelling company goals and long-term success. I thrive in this environment, love being a mentor, and am honored to be known as a friendly, thoughtful, and optimistic leader.
I take great pride in providing caring, supportive mentorship to my team members, ensuring excellent performance at all levels. In addition, I pride myself on helping all employees realize the full benefit of technical resources, especially during periods of process analysis, operations management, and new implementations.
My ability to quickly adapt to new scenarios and projects serves me well. In addition, I have a keen eye for analysis, helping me stay ahead of the curve to meet current and future technological needs. Furthermore, I am a careful listener, allowing me to understand any situation fully.
Through my education and experience, I have developed a deep understanding of the industry’s complexities and truly enjoy both the work’s e creative and technical aspects. In addition, my project management and business development background has provided me with invaluable insight and keen business intelligence, and I am proud of my accomplishments.
 
Going forward, I am eager to use and develop my unique talents to forward the role of project management and business development in the workplace, allowing for systems that breed success. Let’s connect!
